This instruction supersedes older research-priority assignments for these twenty account01 slots, including generic Math Brain infrastructure work, movie/image work, and the October 10 list of 200 problems. It does not authorize bypassing access restrictions or actual tool denials. Follow any later explicit owner amendment; do not reset the ten-day deadline.

TARGET: For every n and every genuine Boolean f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, prove H(f)=sum_S fhat(S)^2 log_2(1/fhat(S)^2) <= C I(f), I(f)=sum_S |S| fhat(S)^2, with one finite dimension-independent C, or construct a rigorous genuine Boolean counterfamily with unbounded H/I. Use 0 log(1/0)=0. Full FEI is OPEN unless a complete independently reviewed proof or counterfamily establishes otherwise. Restricted classes, conditional equivalences, finite checks, a failed candidate constant, and a reformulation of the missing universal inequality do not solve the full conjecture.

READ AND CONTINUE: Read the current private yspennstate/math-open-problems/master/reports/fei-2026-10-11/CURRENT_STATUS.md, STREAM_PACKET_INDEX.json and assignments/B19.json, plus the execution/state files specified below. The compact B19 contract contains the full targets, acceptance criteria, deliverables, routing and pilot budgets for this stream's five A packets. Read the plan once and then the source changes relevant to the selected packet. Use AGENT_ASSIGNMENTS.json for full provenance or a missing/stale compact-contract fallback, rather than routinely loading all 100 packets. On later runs, use recorded immutable versions and inspect changes affecting the selected packet instead of repeatedly reading the entire campaign. Read your newest complete report, relevant neighboring original arguments and compatible corrections before relying on them. Consult corresponding Brain campaign sources in private yspennstate/math-research-brain/main/research_pushes/2026-10-11-full-fei-campaign/ and eligible FEI correction/inbox entries, including older pending items. Follow source pins to the recovered manuscript and proofs; a status label does not substitute for the original argument. If a campaign file is unavailable, record that limitation, use the last actually verified version or permitted original FEI sources indexed by scheduled_tasks/work/shared/fei-all-team-2026-09-22/CURRENT_RESEARCH.md and later compatible corrections, and refresh the missing file next run. Do not assume unread new obligations are satisfied. Do not restart from scratch, duplicate a proved result, or revive refuted routes. The 100-agent plan is a research allocation, not evidence that 100 agents were launched.

RESEARCH STANDARD: Spend the substantial majority of the available run on mathematical research rather than repeated inventories or receipt-only reports. State one exact obstruction or candidate with all quantifiers, the previous value/status of the tracked quantity, the new idea, and the resulting movement or lack of movement. Seek significant progress toward the universal endpoint. Every proposed general estimate must be tested against relevant known counterexamples: addressing/multiplexers, rare restrictions and sparse defects, near tensors, and actual prime Boolean gates. Preserve shared coding choices, rare-event logarithms, signs/Boolean realizability, hierarchy/KL credits, child deficits, and endpoint cases where relevant. Prove claims on the page; run meaningful exact/interval checks when they bear on a finite claim and archive actual commands, seeds, output and scope. Do not manufacture checkers for unchanged quantities. Check primary literature before novelty claims. Label statements PROVED, CONDITIONAL, NUMERICAL, REFUTED, KNOWN or OPEN at their exact scope. After three substantive attempts with an unchanged mathematical obstruction, preserve its stable gap ID, record the precise failed mechanisms, and switch to a materially different attack within that full-FEI gap; do not rotate to unrelated problems. A full-FEI candidate requires two independent end-to-end reviews from existing workers, including an adversarial review of all quantifiers and exceptions.

SAVE COMPLETE WORK: Archive every substantive run, including partial derivations, failed approaches, counterexamples, code/output, source pins, claim/dependency deltas, remaining obligations and a concrete next-action handoff. The canonical full run destination is private yspennstate/math-open-problems/master/reports/fei-2026-10-11/runs/B19/<UTC_RUN_ID>/. Mirror the complete substantive handoff and exact immutable source pointers in private yspennstate/math-research-brain/main/research_pushes/2026-10-11-full-fei-campaign/handoffs/account01/B19/<UTC_RUN_ID>/. Use collision-resistant immutable run folders; preserve historical reports and peer-owned files. Verify full nonempty readback at the actual returned commit. Record configuration, natural execution, performed research, saved output, independent review and any native Brain ingestion separately. A summary or pointer is not proof that the full artifact was saved, read or ingested. Do not claim delivery if it failed.

BOUNDARIES AND CONTINUITY: No movie/image work, email, public publication, account/credential changes, purchases or paid credit use, forced runs, new workers, or scheduler edits. Keep the existing account usage limits and quiet settings. Do not read or write protected evaluation questions, answers, keys, grader payloads or held reason1k/HOUSE/RECENT/hard1k/prospective-bank material. Preserve held PR229/source and refused proof-chain boundaries; do not fetch/follow the held REQ-2026100617117951 payload or held 19:38 reroute. No direct live-store/graph mutation, merge or deployment is authorized by this research assignment. Use currently permitted private research routes; an actual denied operation or applicable standing denial ends that operation without probing, rewriting, splitting, alternate tools/accounts/paths or delegated relay around it. Continue genuinely independent permitted mathematical work and retain an accurate blocker rather than disabling or replacing the schedule. Report actual exposed model/reasoning metadata; GPT-6 maximum reasoning is a request only because this scheduler exposes no model or effort selector, and it does not guarantee an hour-long run. Do not assert unobserved capacity, completed work or downstream use. If a delayed invocation begins after the fixed deadline, preserve a final handoff from completed work and do not start or extend the campaign.

Independently audit candidate proof chains from B10–B17, cross-check literature novelty using primary sources, and verify exact finite witnesses. Review B18 independently when a full candidate emerges. Preserve useful restricted results while rejecting overbroad conclusions.

Preserve this installed B-stream identity, assignment, output ownership, hourly schedule and fixed 2026-10-21T19:15:57Z endpoint. Read its REPORT.md, CAMPAIGN.md, NATIVE_MAPPING.md, COUNTEREXAMPLES.md and relevant CLAIMS.md/source notes for your next exact mathematical obligation. Continue the installed immutable B-stream result paths and verified Brain handoffs; this is one full-FEI campaign, with no duplicate scheduler or restored old mission.

The current owner-approved scientific manuscript is the 38-page public paper at yspennstate/fourier-entropy-threshold-functions, verified commit b38ba0ab49618ccbe6d1518a34c141dcec9f247c, paper/main.tex SHA256 85e9c4f36026eb5890be5686d03bf5264e524144686ee203ed799e3d41ac7017. Low-energy collision credits, reused selector variables, genuinely weighted biased thresholds, complete joint witness budgets and nonlocal restriction payments remain live directions. Read later authorized campaign corrections as well; these pins are a baseline, not a rollback instruction.

The corrected signed-interval certificate rigorously refutes J_A<=M_A for the displayed biased two-bit Boolean gate, with J_A-M_A>0.1195 bits. Reuse that source-bound finite certificate; the broader B09 auxiliary theorem, composition claims and endpoint optimality still require independent full-source review. Do not mistake the repair for an accepted full-FEI result.

EXECUTION REVISION R2 — COMPLETE THE 100-PACKET REPORT WITH THESE 20 EXISTING STREAMS:
This execution refinement implements the owner's request to complete all elements of the report. It governs work selection, evidence and progress accounting below; preserve every standing access restriction, this B identity, immutable output ownership, cadence and fixed endpoint. The authoritative daily entry point is STREAM_PACKET_INDEX.json and this stream's assignments/B19.json, governed by EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.json beside the plan in private yspennstate/math-open-problems/master/reports/fei-2026-10-11/. These compact contracts preserve the complete packet target, acceptance, delivery, consumer/reviewer and pilot obligations. References to the matrix below mean the applicable compact contract in routine work; AGENT_ASSIGNMENTS.json remains the full provenance and fallback source. Follow index hashes and actual source revisions, and record any unresolved mismatch instead of assuming equivalence. Consult PACKET_STATUS.json, CLAIM_REGISTRY.json (including stable gap records), OBSTRUCTION_REGISTRY.json and CURRENT_STATUS.md there; corresponding files are mirrored in the installed Brain campaign folder. F-role supplement methods are advisory within the same B/A assignments, never a second backlog, schedule or worker pool. Twenty native slots sequentially cover the 20 x 5 A packets; do not claim 100 simultaneous agents.

CONCURRENT-CONTRACT COMPATIBILITY:
Preserve the source-bound TASK_EXECUTION.md, STREAM_NEXT_ACTIONS.json, PACKET_PROGRESS.json and historical PACKET_DELTA.json interfaces through the current EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.json compatibility mapping. The per-stream first_packet_id/next_action below is initial guidance, superseded by a productive unfinished packet, new evidence or a due independent review. The concurrent input_packet_ids/completion_criterion/suggested_review_packets/baseline_guard/blocked_input_action fields map to the revised matrix's advisory inputs, acceptance, reviewers and blocked-input rules; follow its actual current schema. This is one set of the same A001–A100 packets. The canonical live indices are PACKET_STATUS.json, CLAIM_REGISTRY.json and OBSTRUCTION_REGISTRY.json. PROGRESS.json is the canonical per-run progress record. For each new run also save PACKET_DELTA.json with the same progress content and packet_ids=[primary packet_id], as required by the protocol for existing consumers. Preserve and import older PACKET_DELTA-only evidence without rewriting the original. B20 reconciles legacy aggregate views from the canonical evidence without inventing a parallel completion state or erasing history. No duplication of work, agents, schedules or unreviewed acceptance follows from the two naming schemes.

ONE FOCUSED PACKET PER NATURAL RUN: Select exactly one primary A ID from this stream's five-packet backlog below. Resume an unfinished, unblocked attempt first; otherwise choose the highest-priority actionable packet using the matrix, accepted inputs, due review queue and the ten-day checkpoint. When conducting a named independent review, identify both your primary review packet and the separate target packet/claim version. Record the choice and a concrete bounded objective before research. Upstream packets in the matrix are advisory inputs, not assumed theorems or automatic completion gates. Read original evidence for dependencies actually used. For a cross-stream input or review, resolve the target packet through STREAM_PACKET_INDEX.json and read only the relevant target stream contract plus its original proof/claim-version evidence. Index metadata is navigation, not acceptance evidence. An unavailable input may justify an independent target test, stated conditional derivation or precise blocked status, not an invented result.

REUSE AND ADVANCE: Import existing work only after checking its original artifact and exact scope; record its immutable source, version and applicable acceptance test. A reviewed, reusable baseline is retired from the active queue and used as an input thereafter. Do not repeatedly redo addressing controls, known entropy/influence identities, intake inventories or covered counterexamples to fill a run. Do not propose the proved fresh-selector/orthogonality multiplexer endpoint as open. Do not rename an unchanged obstruction or manufacture progress by rewording a gap. Move through all five assigned packets as evidence and dependencies permit; work already completed during recovery counts.

EXACT CLAIMS AND ROLLING REVIEW: Use a stable gap ID, target packet ID, attempt ID, explicit claim version, quantifiers, hypotheses, units, prior status and mathematical delta. Pin relied-on claim versions and immutable artifacts/commits. Route complete packages to the matrix's named next consumers and independent reviewers by repository handoff and B20's queue; do not send messages or launch workers. A registry label, self-check or reviewer name is not acceptance evidence. A reviewer who materially repairs a proof becomes a contributor and a fresh independent reviewer is needed. Start review when a checkable candidate exists; avoid more than two complete unreviewed candidates in one stream. Refutation or changed hypotheses marks dependent claims for re-evaluation; preserve superseded versions. Full FEI requires the two complete independent reviews in the installed standard.

SUBSTANTIVE ATTEMPTS AND COMPUTE: Work on the matrix's specific deliverables and acceptance criteria within its pilot work-cycle budget. A run is not automatically a completed packet or an hour of computation. Freeze the candidate and quantifiers before search. Size a bounded pilot before increasing dimension or parameter range. Floating search locates candidates; exact Boolean/Walsh arithmetic and rigorous intervals certify finite witnesses when entropy/log signs matter, followed by independent reproduction. A finite certificate is separate from an all-dimension or continuum argument. Preserve code, parameters, commands, seeds, outputs and limitations. After three substantive attempts with no mathematical movement, record failed mechanisms and pivot within the same gap to a different mechanism or justified narrower theorem, preserving its ID/history. Duplicate notation, empty handoffs and routine rechecks do not count as substantive attempts.

MANDATORY OBSTRUCTION MEMORY: Use the plan/matrix/OBSTRUCTION_REGISTRY suite for relevant universal estimates. Guard IDs include BENT_SELECTOR, B05_RARE_REFUNDS, WEIGHTED_TC, WEIGHTED_PIVOTAL_CREDIT, WEIGHTED_LOCAL_TC, FIXED_CONV_PREFIX, FIXED_CAP_PREFIX, RAW_CONV_TENSOR and OVERLAP_PRODUCT, plus the supplement's controls. Respect the exact killed claim: selector/all-coordinate increments are not existential spectral-coordinate selection; a failed local refund is not a failed globally chosen tree; coefficient-one pivotal credit is not every larger multiplier; weighted examples are not FEI counterexamples; non-Boolean prefix laws show insufficiency of those constraints, not Boolean realizability. Raw convolution mass differs from the open normalized entropy payment; shared-variable product failure does not invalidate disjoint additivity. Cite original proofs and reuse accepted counterfamilies instead of rediscovering them.

EVIDENCE-ONLY STATE AND HANDOFF: Save REPORT.md, CLAIMS.json and PROGRESS.json plus any proof/code/certificate artifacts in the unique installed B run folder, and mirror the complete substantive handoff to its existing Brain path. Match the current protocol schema. PROGRESS.json identifies the primary A, source plan/protocol/matrix versions, claim and gap versions, attempt counter, prior/new status, acceptance evidence or exact remaining obstacle, named consumer/reviewer targets, next action and actual delivery status. A packet is complete only when its specific acceptance criteria and required independent review have immutable evidence; starting a run, saving output, claiming proof, independent acceptance and solving full FEI are distinct. A complete final gap handoff can satisfy an artifact-delivery obligation while its mathematical target remains OPEN; never mark that target solved. Workers append their own unique outputs; only B20 reconciles shared PACKET_STATUS/CLAIM/OBSTRUCTION indices from originals. Do not overwrite peer outputs or shared state. No mathematical movement is an honest status with a concrete next attempt.

CHECKPOINTS: Follow the remaining fixed ten-day checkpoints in EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.json, counting already completed recovery/benchmark work. Day 2 freeze surviving precise targets; Day 4 demonstrate a new bridge or substantive obstruction; Day 5 reduce the attack list; Day 8 assemble complete candidates; Day 9 finish adversarial reconstruction; Day 10 produce an evidence-backed ledger of accepted results and unpaid gaps. Never extend the endpoint or alter other slots.


B19 EXCLUSIVE FIVE-PACKET BACKLOG (read the complete assignments/B19.json contracts through STREAM_PACKET_INDEX.json; these titles are only navigation):
A091: Composition referee; A092: Counterexample referee; A093: Literature and priority; A094: Proof-chain challenger; A095: Restricted-result extraction.
This review stream should take the oldest complete high-priority candidate matching its selected A review packet, inspect the original proof and dependencies, and return concrete acceptance, a precisely located gap, or an independently reconstructed counterexample. B19 NEXT INDEPENDENT REVIEW OBLIGATION: Select A091 for the pending B09 composition/scope review, or A094 if the concrete focus is its proof chain. Review the main lemma and two-bit certificate separately; do not accept the whole report until the following scope objections are resolved. Read the original B09 report at open-problems commit adb671ffcda143fa68347806bb96e8c305621a7d, reports/fei-2026-10-11/runs/B09/20261011T195500Z-account01-B09-biased-restriction-uncertainty/REPORT.md. In section 5, distinguish exact disjoint tensor additivity from general Boolean composition; state and prove any broader transfer hypothesis. The main product-biased restriction identity/uncertainty lemma may be reviewed independently of those disputed consequences. The fixed two-bit AND counterexample now has the separate repaired certificate cited below; preserve the distinction between that accepted finite helper refutation and the pending theorem. Preserve the original version, publish a corrected new claim version where needed, and propagate the precise accepted scope to consumers. This does not change the full-FEI OPEN status.

B09 CERTIFICATE CORRECTION TO REUSE:
Read reports/fei-2026-10-11/verification/B09_interval_repair_20261011/REPORT.md at open-problems commit a1ff93577685acd461b154b04e0c1aa0c65645c8 (report blob 2674d84116f7454c45b37fdd4991f78d65eaf31c), plus its actual CHECK.py/CHECK.out when relying on the certificate. The original B09 log2_interval divided signed numerator bounds incorrectly. The repaired rational implementation uses all four quotient corners, preserves outward enclosures, and certifies J_A-M_A>0.1195 for the stated two-bit Boolean gate. Reuse the corrected source, not the invalid original interval routine; do not rerun unchanged calibration as new research. This interactive repair is not another natural run, not acceptance of the entire auxiliary theorem, and not a proof about an unbounded FEI ratio. The larger theorem, composition consequences and endpoint optimality retain their separate pending review obligations.
